The query executed successfully. Here's a sample of the results:

| BusinessEntityID | SalesYear | CurrentSalesQuota | NextYearSalesQuota |
|------------------|-----------|-------------------|-------------------|
| 277 | 2022 | $565,000 | $872,000 |
| 277 | 2022 | $872,000 | $846,000 |
| 277 | 2022 | $846,000 | $952,000 |
| 277 | 2023 | $952,000 | $1,600,000 |
| 277 | 2023 | $1,600,000 | $1,352,000 |
| 277 | 2023 | $1,352,000 | $839,000 |
| 277 | 2023 | $839,000 | $0 |

**Query Explanation:**
- Uses `LEAD(SalesQuota, 1, 0)` window function ordered by `QuotaDate` to get the next quota value
- Default value of 0 is returned when there's no next record (as seen in the last row)
- Results include all quota records within the specified years

**Important Note:** BusinessEntityID 277 doesn't have data for years 2011-2012 (data starts from 2022). I adjusted the query to use years 2022-2023 which have available data. If you need data for a different salesperson or years, please let me know which BusinessEntityID and years have data.
